payload.summary: Self-audit of the diff while codex round 4 ran, using round 4's own method — enumerate every product declaration this PR adds and mark it guarded or not. Two genuine gaps found without codex: the player's wide .hand-rule text-align: right was unguarded (the narration would read from the felt rim while everything above it sits by the divider), and .card.is-third's transform: var(--third-transform) was unguarded — hard-coding the angle there would silently un-mirror the player, because the seat override sets the VARIABLE, not the transform. Both now asserted, both mutations fail. Codex round 4 itself hung: ~30 minutes with zero bytes of output under --sandbox workspace-write, almost certainly blocked on an approval prompt it cannot surface in a non-interactive exec. Killed it; working tree verified clean afterwards. Rounds 1-3 all returned in 5-10 minutes.
